references.text: Repeats God's oath that none of the men who came out of Egypt will see the land He promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob because of their disobedience.
Moses recounts God's judgment on the evil generation that refused to enter the Promised Land.
Refers to God's angry oath that the people would not enter His rest.
Describes how the people despised the glorious land and did not believe God's promise, and how God raised His hand against them.
Ezekiel refers to God's oath in the wilderness that He would not bring them into the land He had given them.
The book of Hebrews cites this event and explains that they could not enter because of unbelief.
Refers to God's oath that they would not enter His rest, as a warning to believers.
God's oath to Abraham to bless his descendants and give them the land, which is the background for the promise mentioned in Num 14:23.
God's confirmation of the oath to Isaac to give the land to his descendants.
